meta.note: Fixed task set. Each task names the single ground-truth tool a correct turn should call (expected_tool), or null when the turn should answer directly with no tool. subset=core: expected tool is in the curated set, so all three conditions can answer it (isolates the distractor/count effect). subset=coverage: expected tool was cut from the curated set, so curated cannot answer it (measures the cost of over-curation). subset=none: no tool should be called (measures over-triggering).
